agentRuntime.thesisBody: Dispatch = Agent × Runtime × Task → Session. The carrier is not the identity (ADR-0028).
agentRuntime.legendReadyTip: Authentication verified; the instance can take dispatches.
agentRuntime.legendPartialTip: Authentication has not been checked yet; the background probe is non-blocking.
agentRuntime.legendBlockedTip: Authentication failed, or the instance is disabled.
agentRuntime.providerEditHint: Credentials and call-path configuration stay unchanged.
agentRuntime.authClaudePlane: Subscription login plus API mode, on one instance
agentRuntime.authCodexPlane: Subscription and API are separate instances
agentRuntime.authAgyPlane: Subscription login only; no API mode
agentRuntime.apiKeySealed: The key lives in the OS keychain; the GUI never reads it back.
agentRuntime.claudeApiOverrideOn: API override is on: the base URL and model decide the actual service (for example GLM).
agentRuntime.claudeApiOverrideOff: Running on the default subscription login. To use a third-party API, turn on the API override when creating an instance.
agentRuntime.isolationHint: One permission mode per instance; isolation decides between a dedicated state root and the operator environment.
agentRuntime.permissionsUnsupported: This provider owns its own access policy; harness adds no permission mode.
agentRuntime.dangerHint: Deleting also clears this instance's state root and credential reference. There is no undo.
agentRuntime.roleWorkerTip: Executor: takes a mission and does the work.
agentRuntime.roleCommanderTip: Commander: reads the roster, splits the work, and dispatches.
agentRuntime.roleModelDecoupled: Role is fully decoupled from model and provider — any model can be a commander.
agentRuntime.instructionsDesc: The soul — this text becomes the agent's system prompt verbatim
agentRuntime.instructionsHint: Stored and delivered without any wrapping or rewriting: monospace, what you see is what it gets.
agentRuntime.skillsDesc: Capability packs detected from user and project roots and injected into prompts
agentRuntime.presetDesc: How a task is specialised — the package shape and its completion gates
agentRuntime.presetHint: Leave empty to bind no preset.
agentRuntime.promptsDesc: Reusable instructions — pick one at dispatch instead of retyping
agentRuntime.runtimeConstraintDesc: Declares a type, never an instance — the instance is chosen at dispatch
agentRuntime.runtimeConstraintNote: An agent declaration binds no concrete runtime instance. The same role can run on claude, codex, or agy.
agentRuntime.dispatchHint: Spawn goes through the daemon; the prompt arrives on stdin.
agentRuntime.taskBindingTip: A squad lives inside a task; it cannot exist without one.
agentRuntime.squadTaskBound: Dispatching requires a task; the squad's lifetime follows it.
agentRuntime.formationDesc: Commander and worker slots — click a slot to configure it below
agentRuntime.pickSlot: Pick a slot above to configure it
agentRuntime.commanderSlotHint: The commander does not execute; it reads the roster and dispatches.
agentRuntime.workerSlotHint: An executor that works the mission.
agentRuntime.slotRoleHint: A slot only decides who is in the formation; the wording of the role lives in the roster.
agentRuntime.rosterDesc: The natural-language roster the leader actually reads
agentRuntime.rosterHint: The leader does no capability scoring: it reads this roster and decides in natural language.
agentRuntime.rosterWarn: The wording is load-bearing configuration: write what each member can do, not what each member is.
agentRuntime.launchSquadHint: Opens a dispatch for one roster worker. Whole-roster fan-out is CLI-only (ha squad run).
agentRuntime.noResultYet: This session has no result text yet.
agentRuntime.transcriptNoRecord: No dispatch record is available for this session.
agentRuntime.livenessFromChild: Liveness and exit code come from the child-process events.
agentRuntime.newRuntimeHint: Pick a witnessed installation; never type a path
agentRuntime.plane_claude: Subscription plus API on one instance: override the base URL and model to adapt a third party such as GLM.
agentRuntime.plane_codex: Codex-family models only; subscription and API are two separate call paths, each its own instance.
agentRuntime.plane_agy: Subscription login only; there is no API mode.
agentRuntime.noWitnessedInstallation: No {kind} installation witnessed — install it on this machine and put it on PATH.
agentRuntime.callPathAgy: AGY supports only its own login flow: there is no key or endpoint to fill in.
agentRuntime.callPathCodex: Each call path is its own instance; the choice is fixed after creation.
agentRuntime.callPathClaude: Left off, the instance uses the default subscription login. Turned on, this same instance calls the API — no second instance needed.
agentRuntime.name: Name
agentRuntime.modelHint_claude: Any claude-compatible model; for a third-party API use that provider's model name.
agentRuntime.baseUrlHint: Point at a third-party endpoint here; leave empty for the official one.
agentRuntime.apiKeyHint: Typed once at creation, stored in the OS keychain; the daemon only ever sees an opaque reference.
agentRuntime.createSubscriptionWarn: Creating hands straight off to the provider's own login terminal.
agentRuntime.createApiWarn: The key leaves the form exactly once; after it reaches the keychain it is never refilled or kept in renderer memory.
agentRuntime.newAgentHint: Identity layer — who does the work
agentRuntime.newAgentFooter: A template copies that agent's instructions and configuration, replacing only the identity.
agentRuntime.newSquadFooter: task_binding: required — launching one always needs a task.
agentRuntime.blankAgentDesc: No template; write the instructions yourself.
agentRuntime.blankSquadDesc: No template; build the formation yourself.
agentRuntime.blankAgentWarn: A blank agent ships with placeholder instructions. Rewrite them immediately: that text is its entire behaviour.
agentRuntime.blankSquadWarn: A blank squad has a leader and no workers. Fill the formation in after creating it.
agentRuntime.blankInstructions: (To be written: this text becomes the agent's system prompt verbatim.)
agentRuntime.idInvalid: id must be a lowercase slug
agentRuntime.dispatchOrderHint: The order is the argument: who, then what, then the words, and only then the carrier
agentRuntime.stepWhoHint: Fixed — you came in from its card
agentRuntime.squadRouting: One dispatch, one worker: pick below; routed through the squad leader. {count} in roster
agentRuntime.twoAxes: Identity (agent) and carrier (runtime) are two separate axes — ADR-0028.
agentRuntime.noTasks: This repository has no dispatchable task yet.
agentRuntime.leaseAutoAcquire: The execution lease is acquired on dispatch. A task whose lease is held can still be picked, but may be refused.
agentRuntime.missionFiling: Filed on dispatch: the mission lands in the task package, the dispatch record is generated, and the report is archived beside them.
agentRuntime.dispatchBlocked: This agent's declaration is blocked; fix it before dispatching.
agentRuntime.sessionTaskNone: This session is not bound to a task.
agentRuntime.selfTestHint: One real round trip through this runtime
agentRuntime.selfTestTimeout: The runtime did not finish the self-test in time.
agentRuntime.agentsSubtitle: identity and organisation · dispatch from here
agentRuntime.emptyAgents: No agent or squad yet. Create one from the rail.
agentRuntime.emptyProviders: No runtime instance yet. Create one from the rail.
agentRuntime.sessionsSearchPlaceholder: Search task / agent / instance / dispatch / status…
agentRuntime.sessionsNoMatches: No matching sessions; narrow the query or widen the range.
agentRuntime.sessionsGroupsTruncated: First {count} groups listed (more matched); narrow the search.
agentRuntime.squadRunsEmpty: No squad runs yet. Start one with `ha squad run`; leader turns and worker attempts will appear here as units.
agentRuntime.squadRunsTruncated: First {count} runs listed ({total} total); narrow the search.
agentRuntime.squadRunsEmptyWindow: No squad runs in this range ({range}). Widen the range or clear the search.
agentRuntime.squadRunSelectEmpty: Select a squad run to see its leader-to-worker fan-out tree.
